no_password_subtitle: So no one else can claim it first, the password can only be set the first time from the hub's local network.
open_on_lan: Open this page on a computer or phone on the same local network as the hub, or
run_reset: Run {command} on the hub machine to set the password directly.
setup_subtitle: This is your first visit. Set a password to sign in with from now on.
code_intro: Setting the first password takes a one-time setup code, to confirm it's someone who can work on the hub machine. It's valid for 10 minutes and works once. Get it from any of these:
code_from_logs: The hub's startup log has it too: {systemd} for the background service (it keeps its old name), {docker} for Docker
code_from_setup: The admin address {command} printed at the end of installing: open that address and the code fills in by itself
code_prefilled: The setup code came with the address the installer printed (valid for 10 minutes, works once). Just pick a password.
forgot_later: If you forget it, run {command} on the hub machine.
forgot: Forgot it? Run {command} on the hub machine.
